title: VCMI combat script format
description: Format used to define scripts that react to combat events in VCMI

type.description: Type of script, such as built-in or Lua

compatibilityIdentifiers.description: Additional identifiers that may refer to this object, to provide compatibility after object has been renamed

script.description: path to the script that represents this combat script

description.description: description of the ability shown to the player, may refer to script parameters as ${parameterName}

priority.description: order in which scripts reacting to the same combat event run, from lowest to highest. Defaults to 0

items.description: list of patches that modify this script
